comment: Registry of per-release navigation performance baselines. See docs/NATIVE_DESKTOP_PERF_BASELINES.md for the rules: request counters are exact gates against the local mock server, timing and RSS gates are documented bands derived from measured runs on the reference stand (Xvnc :30 1440x900 + openbox, llvmpipe) per the issue #16 rule - never one host's hard number without a named fluctuation source. Band source measurement: two independent capture runs on 2026-11-10, per-phase spread at most 2 ms, total 845-846 ms, peak RSS 277,068-277,144 KiB, cache hits 4. New scenarios register here; the harness and tooling test are deliberately outside CTest.
